events.verdict: Williams (UTA) places his off-arm against Williams (BKN) without extending into him.
Collier (UTA) swipes down at the ball and avoids making illegal contact during Williams' (BKN) driving shot attempt.
Williams (BKN) brushes Sexton's (UTA) arm on the perimeter and the contact is marginal.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms if Sensabaugh (UTA) steps out of bounds.
Martin (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Claxton (BKN) contests Collier's (UTA) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Sensabaugh (UTA) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Williams (BKN), which affects his play at the basket.
Sexton (UTA) reaches in and the contact with Williams' (BKN) front is marginal as he mishandles his dribble.
Collier (UTA) fails to establish frontcourt position within eight seconds.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Claxton (BKN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Claxton is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Simmons (BKN) avoids making body contact with Sensabaugh (UTA) as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Sexton (UTA) swipes down at the ball and initiates illegal contact to Claxton's (BKN) face.
Sexton (UTA) moves laterally into Evbuomwan (BKN), initiating illegal body contact that affects his play near the basket.
Clowney (BKN) reaches for the rebound and the contact with Williams' (UTA) arm is marginal.
Sexton (UTA) lowers his arm to contest Claxton's (BKN) shot attempt and the contact with his non-shooting arm is marginal.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Claxton's (BKN) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim before the shot clock expires.
Collier (UTA) maintains his pivot foot.
Collier (UTA) brings the ball into Claxton's (BKN) knee, which causes it to become dislodged from his possession.
Claxton (BKN) switches his pivot foot after recovering the loose ball.
Claxton (BKN) brings his hand towards Collier's (UTA) path but the contact is marginal as he takes a long dribble.

Replay review of the foul called on Collier (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Collier initiates contact with Evbuomwan's (BKN) head, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Evubuomwan (BKN) and Sexton (UTA) come together at the same spot on the floor and the foot contact is incidental.
The game clock expires prior to any contact occurring between Eubanks (UTA) and Claxton (BKN) during the jump shot attempt.
